stories.title: Show HN: Subvocal – Talk to your computer without making noise
summary: It's a bit weird to do, but with practice, we have been able to get it down pretty well.)Arnav and I were studying CS at Georgia Tech at the beginning of the year, with no experience in silent speech or sensing.
We built a crude prototype, sticking EMG electrodes onto my face:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mwhv5HZMz3UTevdrgwS5O7g2jWV...We got it to kind of work at a letter level in a very janky way.
We set up booths in our office and paid people to read prompts wearing our glasses, to pretrain our models on.

stories.title: Launch HN: Momentic (YC W24) – Agents that catch bugs by using your app
summary: Testing was always a pain in the ass (esp Playwright and Selenium), so we built agents to do it for us.Modern day software has a ton of bugs and the change failure rate is only growing faster as coding agent adoption scales.

We think the future of QA is agents testing themselves, not writing scripts.Mo is a custom agent harness for catching bugs that builds on the past 3 years of Momentic and millions of test traces from complex, real-world applications.

A single bug bash can spin up 100s of concurrent browsers and devices.We benchmarked Mo against coding agents on 4 popular open-source apps: Gitea (58.8k stars), Metabase, Twenty (YC), and Saleor, with 1,396 human-labeled bugs.
